description: Change WAF settings for a pull zone and return what changed. Fields use the names get_shield_zone returns: wafEnabled, wafExecutionMode (0 Log (no rule blocks, including custom Block rules), 1 Block), learningMode, wafDisabledRules, wafLogOnlyRules, dDoSShieldSensitivity and others. A list in `fields` replaces the whole list; to change part of a list use `add` or `remove`, e.g. add: {"wafDisabledRules": ["942100"]}.

add.description: Items to add to list fields

remove.description: Items to remove from list fields

name: update_shield_zone
